name: Subagent Fanout Guard
summary: Cap per-session subagent delegation using a bounded transcript count.
description: Counts prior Task and Agent tool calls in the supplied Claude Code transcript and blocks delegation after a fixed conservative session budget without invoking a model.
risk_reason: This automatic gate caps per-session subagent delegation using a bounded transcript count; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not decide which specialist should be delegated to.
It does not infer concurrency or nesting when the transcript does not encode it.
It does not edit transcripts or terminate already running agents.

entrypoints.purpose: Cap per-session subagent delegation using a bounded transcript count.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint reads and parses up to 4 MiB of transcript before deciding whether to allow delegation.
